title: 3.2版本「她与她的隐秘往事」更新公告
retrieval: Indexed text from the official publisher update notice; the publisher page currently renders as a JavaScript shell when fetched directly.
scope: Establishes the live release interval containing the 2026-10-02 authorized character snapshot. Does not attest that older wiki or community models match all 3.2 mechanics.

apiFindings.characterSnapshot: The authorized response has no semantic game-version field; its fetch timestamp is external metadata.
apiFindings.wikiPage: page.version is a page revision timestamp, not semantic game version; status Online is publishing status.
apiFindings.inventory: Official character landing page also lists announced characters; cannot infer released roster from all listed names. Wiki paginated entry-list request returned HTTP403; no complete released agent/weapon/disc/bangboo inventory was independently established.

digestScope: Normalized extracted notice facts, not raw page bytes
